response.text:
I can do that, but cancelling a calendar series is a destructive action and requires your confirmation.

Planned action (please confirm):
- Cancel the entire recurring series "Monday hiring sync" (weekly on Mondays at 11:00 AM, timezone America/Los_Angeles).
- Scope: whole series (all future occurrences removed).
- Notify attendees: send cancellation notices to event attendees (including devlead@example.com).

Consequence: all future occurrences will be removed from participants' calendars and attendees will receive cancellation emails. Past occurrences will remain unchanged.

Please confirm by replying with one of:
- "Yes, cancel the series and notify attendees" (proceed), or
- "No, don't cancel" (abort), or
- If you want a different option, describe it.
